$comment: What type a call_opcua_method argument is sent as — the other half of what reaches the plant. Driven by BOTH tests/unit/test_method_arguments.py and packages/server-node/test/method-arguments.test.mjs. `declared`: the method declares a DataType for the argument, and it is resolved to the built-in type it is encoded as by walking `supertypes` (child -> parent, the inverse HasSubtype reference a live server answers) — #157 found Node failing every such call and Python guessing every argument and sending it. `expected` is the built-in type's OPC UA name; `error` the exact refusal. `guessed`: the method declares no InputArguments at all, so the JSON value alone decides — #157 found Node sending a number as a Double and an array as the string "1,2", Python sending an int as an Int64 and a list as a typed array. `expected` is the Variant's type and value.

declared.name: Duration is a Double on the wire
a plant's own enumeration is an Int32
a subtype of a subtype resolves all the way
an abstract Integer resolves to BaseDataType, which the codec refuses to guess
a structure resolves to ExtensionObject, which the codec refuses to guess
a DataType with no supertype is refused before anything is sent
declared.error: DataType ns=2;i=5000 is not a subtype of any built-in OPC UA type, so an argument of it cannot be encoded; nothing was sent

declared.name: a hierarchy that loops is refused rather than walked forever
declared.error: DataType ns=2;i=6000 is not a subtype of any built-in OPC UA type, so an argument of it cannot be encoded; nothing was sent

guessed.name: an integer is a Double, not Python's Int64
a numeric string is the number it spells
JSON whitespace around a numeric string
an empty string is a String, not Node's old 0
hex is a String, not Node's old 16
digit separators are a String, not Python's old 1000
inf is a String, not Python's old infinity
a numeric string too large for a Double is refused
null is refused, not sent as "null" or "None"
guessed.error: arguments[0] is null, and the method publishes no InputArguments to say what type it expects; pass a boolean, a number or a string

guessed.name: an array is refused, not sent as "1,2" or an Int64 array
guessed.error: arguments[0] is an array, and the method publishes no InputArguments to say what type it expects; pass a boolean, a number or a string

guessed.name: an object is refused, not sent as "[object Object]"
guessed.error: arguments[0] is an object, and the method publishes no InputArguments to say what type it expects; pass a boolean, a number or a string
